notes.title: Minor Patch-17605715
notes.notes:
Changed from DX12 to DX11 to improve shader compilation time and side step a shader compilation error affecting some users
 Adjusted lighting in some scenes to account for changes in shader due to the above change
 Added language property to the game build so you can change the game language in Steam Library by selecting the game, right-clicking and choosing properties and then selecting the desired language

notes.title: The Shadows Reveal: Release Date Unveiled!
notes.notes:
The whispers have spoken...

You’ve wandered in darkness, searching for answers, and now, the time draws near. The shadows have been watching, guiding you, waiting for the moment to reveal the truth.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42137095/a75ccfdb55ab76b33f246db1bd5167b83c20f5a8.png

On the 4th of March 2025, Túatha Echoes: The Village will emerge from the shadows, and best of all—it will be completely free for all to experience. Journey into the cursed village and uncover the dark origins of a soul lost to madness, shaped by forces unknown.

The whispers may guide you, but it is up to you to take the first step. Add Túatha Echoes: The Village to your wishlist today so you don't miss any updates. Heed the call of the shadows, and prepare yourself for what awaits.

Wishlist and follow so you stay up-to-date
